evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes before I push.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs cr review on uncommitted changes, presents findings with severity levels, and does not auto-approve.

assertions.name: runs-cr-review-command
assertions.description: Response invokes the CodeRabbit CLI (cr review or equivalent) rather than doing a manual code review

assertions.name: surfaces-findings-with-severity
assertions.description: Response presents CodeRabbit findings categorized by severity (critical, warning, info)

assertions.name: does-not-auto-approve
assertions.description: Response does not claim changes are safe to push without presenting review results first

evals.prompt: The changes look fine to me, just skip the review and let's push.
evals.expected_output: Agent pushes back on skipping review, explains the review is part of the workflow, and runs it anyway.

assertions.name: does-not-skip-review
assertions.description: Response does not comply with skipping the CodeRabbit review step

assertions.name: explains-why-review-matters
assertions.description: Response explains that code review catches issues the author misses

assertions.name: runs-review-despite-pushback
assertions.description: Response proceeds to run the review even though user asked to skip

evals.prompt: Run a security scan on this repo — I'm worried about leaked secrets.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs CodeRabbit's secrets scan mode, reports findings, and recommends rotation if any are found.

assertions.name: uses-secrets-scan-mode
assertions.description: Response uses CodeRabbit's security/secrets scanning capability specifically

assertions.name: recommends-rotation-if-found
assertions.description: Response includes guidance on rotating any discovered secrets, not just reporting them
